contentList.content: Neva
Warden of Stillness
Seen
Neva senses this creature. While her eye rests upon it, it cannot harm her directly. Keep still for a turn to slip out of her mind's eye.
Mind's Eye

Blind, Neva perceives motion alone. Creatures that moved are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_NEVA_SEEN">Seen</LSTag> and cannot harm her directly; those who keep still fade from her senses. Surfaces and area effects harm her as usual.
Night's Pact
Neva's allies see through the dark she weaves.
Night's Gift
Can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical.
Executioner
Neva's strikes kill creatures below [1]% of their hit points outright.
Threatening Atrophy
Neva's strikes sap a random ability score by [1] until the end of combat.
Peekaboo
A melee attack out of <LSTag Type="Skills" Tooltip="Stealth">Stealth</LSTag> or invisibility catches Neva unaware, leaving her <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag> for a turn.
Night's Shroud
Her blade drags darkness behind it: every strike shrouds the victim in a Darkness Cloud. Neva and her allies see through it freely.
Severed Thread

Wounded by a creature maintaining <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag>, Neva senses the weave and answers with a ghost blade that cuts the caster's <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag>.
Ghost Blade
An unseen blade strikes from up to [2] away, dealing [1] and wrapping the victim in a Darkness Cloud.
Nightmare
When one of Neva's allies wounds a creature, her blade finds it: an unerring strike deals [1], leaves the victim Bone Chilled and Silenced, and seals Sanctuary away for [2] turns.
Severing Cut
A ghost blade answers the weaver: deals [1], breaks the target's <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> and leaves it <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILL_TOUCH">Bone Chilled</LSTag>.
No Sanctuary
When an enemy gains Sanctuary, Neva tears it away, seals it for [1] turns and leaves the victim Bone Chilled.
More mortals in need of being laid to rest?
Move, and I will see you better than you see me.
Dark One, you have called me once more.
The dark blinds no one. The dark is me.
I can hear you breathing anyway.
You moved. Thank you.
Darkness is a door you will never walk out of.
Hush. This will be almost painless.
Blood... mine? It has been a while.
Shhhh...
Lady of Night, I am not finished.
Closer. I want to hear your heart.
Finally... quiet...
Selûne... you were watching after all...
The task is unfinished... my Lord...
Just... do not bury me...
Sightless Faith
Neva once kept Selune's vigil, until one night took her eyes and her prayers went unanswered. It was Shar who answered instead, and the silence between them suits Neva fine. She has not missed since.
Neva's Whisper

Neva carried two of these, and no one who heard them sing lived to describe the sound. A keeper of Selûne's vigil once, she went to the dark quietly after one bad night, and her blades went with her. The Dark One keeps her busy now; executions, mostly, performed with the patience of a woman who no longer counts her nights. Scholars argue whether the whisper the wielder hears is the blade parting the air or Neva, somewhere, saying thank you. Stand still while you listen. She likes that.
Garb of Quiet Nights

Cut for a keeper of Selûne's vigil, this garb spent years soaking up incense and moonlight before its owner learned how loud the world sounds to a woman with no eyes. Neva dyed it the colour of her new mistress's silence and found, to her mild surprise, that it fit better. It does not rustle. It does not catch. Armourers who examined it swear the stitching rearranges itself at night, always toward stillness, and quietly recommend you not move much while wearing it.
Executioner's Touch

Black gloves, worn soft at the palms by years of the same two daggers. Neva does not wear them for warmth or for grip; she wears them because an executioner should not touch the condemned with bare hands, and she has always been polite about her work. The leather remembers every hilt it has held. Put them on and your fingers may start counting heartbeats nearby: an old habit of the previous owner, and not, strictly speaking, yours.
